name: Autonomous Code Engineering
description: Enables the Engineering Agent to autonomously write, fix, optimize, and deploy code across the DoctaRx platform. Uses novel algorithmic approaches and state-of-the-art patterns.

steps.description: Gather recent errors, performance bottlenecks, and code health metrics
steps.query: SELECT * FROM agent_task_queue WHERE task_type IN ('bugfix', 'feature', 'optimization') AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY priority DESC LIMIT 10

steps.description: Map the current codebase architecture and identify improvement opportunities
Use Gemini to generate optimal code solutions
steps.prompt_template: As the DoctaRx Engineering Agent, analyze {{task}} and generate a production-ready solution using novel algorithms. Consider: performance O(n) complexity, HIPAA compliance, error resilience, real-time capability. Use advanced patterns: event sourcing, CQRS, circuit breakers, adaptive rate limiting.

steps.description: Run generated code in sandbox to validate correctness
Apply validated changes to the codebase with backup

novel_algorithms.adaptive_circuit_breaker: Self-adjusting failure threshold based on exponential moving average of error rates. Transitions: CLOSED -> HALF_OPEN -> OPEN with probabilistic recovery.
novel_algorithms.predictive_cache: ML-driven cache pre-warming using access pattern prediction with Markov chain models for patient data retrieval patterns.
novel_algorithms.smart_rate_limiter: Token bucket with dynamic refill rate adjusted by time-of-day demand curves and user behavioral clustering.
novel_algorithms.resilient_queue: Dead letter queue with automatic retry scheduling using fibonacci backoff and poison pill detection.
novel_algorithms.zero_copy_serialization: Schema-aware binary serialization for internal service communication eliminating JSON parse overhead.
